title: Native math-parser completeness contract
implemented: Reinspects current canonical parser, preserves it, and isolates its partial-consumption behavior using an additive full-consumption Pratt parser returning native Node values. Checks precedence, associativity, unary signs, round trips, token/node/depth limits and the inherited independent strict-expression parser.
remaining: The native parser itself remains unchanged and unsafe for unsupported calls that bypass the complete adapter.
Owner-reviewed canonical caller migration, whole-repository compatibility checks and post-merge verification remain open.
